fields.title: Path column
fields.description: The Path column that contains the paths which should be deleted.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Fail if delete fails
fields.description: If this option is checked, the node will fail if one of the files/folders could not be deleted, i.e., it could not be accessed. If it is unchecked, the output table will contain a column that indicates whether a file/folder was successfully deleted or not.

fields.title: Fail if file does not exist
fields.description: If this option is checked, the node will fail if one of the files/folders does not exist.
